title: Demo name interpolated into filesystem paths without sanitization
evidence:
harness/main.odin:131:
	path := fmt.tprintf("demos/%s.dem", name)
harness/goldens.odin:55:
	return fmt.tprintf("goldens/%s/%05dms.png", demo, ms)
detail: The CLI-supplied demo name is used raw in read/write paths (demos/%s.dem, goldens/%s/..., %s.t1, %s.log.bin). A name with ../ escapes the workspace dirs. Today only the trusted local operator supplies names (the demos/ scan yields single path components), so this is not exploitable across a boundary.
recommended_fix: Reject demo names containing '/', '\', '..' or NUL in run_demo/run_replay before path construction; the demos/ scan already constrains names to single components.

title: raylib fetched by mutable tag over HTTPS with no commit hash or checksum, then linked into the golden pipeline
evidence:
tools/build_raylib_sw.sh:25:
  git clone --depth 1 --branch "$RAYLIB_TAG" https://github.com/raysan5/raylib.git "$SRC"
tools/build_raylib_sw.sh:68:
cp "$OBJ/libraylib_sw.a" "$SHADOW/vendor/raylib/$PLATDIR/libraylib.a"
detail: The shadow root's libraylib.a is compiled from a tag-pinned (not commit-pinned) remote clone with no checksum verification. A force-moved tag or tampered source silently changes the T2 pixel baseline the harness compares against. Prototype-acceptable, but the trust root of the golden tier is a mutable remote.
recommended_fix: Pin the clone to a commit SHA (git clone --branch 6.0 followed by checkout of a recorded sha) and record the sha in the script; optionally verify a checksum of the vendored libraylib_sw.a.
